name: Publix Refrigerated DC Deerfield Beach FL

fieldNotes.truckGate: Divided entrance off SW 10th St with a gatehouse in the median; satellite shows painted STOP bars, directional arrows and IN/OUT/TRUCKS lane markings; Street View shows signage splitting traffic into 'Publix VEHICLES' (left) and 'TRUCK DELIVERIES' (right) lanes.
fieldNotes.guardShack: Small staffed booth with a teal/green roof in the entrance median, set beside the lanes, separate from the main building (visible in z19/z21 satellite and behind the median tree in Street View).
fieldNotes.remoteGs: False because a manned guard booth is present.
fieldNotes.entryExitSeparate: Inbound and outbound are physically split into separate lanes around the gatehouse median (vehicles vs truck-deliveries), so entry and exit are separate lane groups at the single gate location.
fieldNotes.exitLanes: Estimated 1 dedicated outbound lane; exact split obscured by median landscaping in Street View - flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Very wide, deep entrance apron with multiple lanes and ample unused paved width to add an express bypass.
fieldNotes.preGateStaging: Large paved apron between the public road and the gatehouse (also confirmed in Street View) where trucks can wait before the booth.
fieldNotes.postGateStaging: Open paved yard inside the gate before the dock banks provides queue space.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: 120 is an honest overhead estimate across the main building (east, west and south dock banks) plus the north building's east dock face; clearly in the 50+ band.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Two large trailer-storage lots full of parked trailers without tractors (north drop yard ~14.5 ac and the SE angled drop yard ~5.4 ac); well into the 50+ band.
fieldNotes.dropYard: Dedicated trailer-storage lots distinct from active dock staging.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Distinct dock clusters on different building faces (east vs west of the main building, plus the separate north building's dock bank).
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: Campus: a separate large north building (two-tone roof with its own east-facing dock doors) plus the main DC building and an ancillary structure by the SE drop yard.
fieldNotes.railServed: A rail line runs along the western property edge behind a landscaped buffer and fence, but no spur enters the property.
fieldNotes.scale: No truck scale/weigh pad identified in the truck path; cannot fully rule out - flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.trailersVisible: ~165 trailers counted across drop yards and dock faces in the captured imagery; approximate.
fieldNotes.siteAreaAcres: 76.4 ac derived from the traced perimeter polygon.
